The method suitability testing is required to demonstrate the drug product test samples do not inhibit growth in sterility test media. For example; 1. The firm performs in-house sterility testing on all intrathecal sterile drug products that include such finished products as: morphine sulfate injection, morphine/baclofen injection, hydromorphone/bupivacaine injection, and, morphine/fentany1/clonidine injection.
